invariants.description: turnover (exact): copies are degraded at r_deg = k_deg m min(f_ATP, 1) and replaced up to the goal at r_rep = k_deg R_syn min(m, m_goal) min(f_ATP, 1); r_down = r_rep - r_deg is never positive, and is 0 at the goal with synthesis unregulated
invariants.expr: np.allclose(r_deg, k_deg*m*np.minimum(f_ATP, 1), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(r_rep, k_deg*R_syn*np.minimum(m, m_goal)*np.minimum(f_ATP, 1), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-18) and np.allclose(r_down, r_rep - r_deg, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-18) and np.all(r_down <= 1e-18)

invariants.description: costs (exact): J_keep = n_0 L ((c_poly + c_recycle) r_rep + c_deg r_deg) / N_A (at the goal n L (c_poly + c_deg + c_recycle) k_deg min(f_ATP, 1) / N_A), J_demand = r_up n_0 L (c_syn + c_poly) / N_A, J_build = J_demand s_build min(f_ATP, 1) - J_saved with J_saved = (c_syn - c_recycle) phi_aa n_0 L r_build / N_A, J_prot = c_deg n_0 L r_prot / N_A, J_ATP = J_keep + J_build + J_prot, M_build = n L (c_syn + c_poly) / N_A, A_protein = n_0 footprint m, share = A_protein / A_ceiling, s_unit = n_0 footprint / A_ceiling
invariants.expr: np.allclose(J_keep, n_0*L*((c_poly + c_recycle)*r_rep + c_deg*r_deg)/N_A, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_demand, np.maximum(m_goal - m, 0)/tau*n_0*L*(c_syn + c_poly)/N_A, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(J_saved, (c_syn - c_recycle)*phi_aa*n_0*L*r_build/N_A, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(J_build, J_demand*s_build*np.minimum(f_ATP, 1) - J_saved, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(J_prot, c_deg*n_0*L*r_prot/N_A, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ATP, J_keep + J_build + J_prot, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(M_build, n_0*m*L*(c_syn + c_poly)/N_A, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(A_protein, n_0*footprint*1e-6*m, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(share, A_protein/A_ceiling, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(s_unit, n_0*footprint*1e-6/A_ceiling, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: proteolysis and recycling (exact): r_prot = max(m - m_goal, 0) / tau_prot s_prot min(f_ATP, 1), Q_prot_demand = n_0 L max(m - m_goal, 0) / tau_prot, Q_aa_rel = n_0 L (r_prot - r_down) >= 0, Q_aa_use = n_0 L phi_aa r_build
invariants.expr: np.allclose(r_prot, np.maximum(m - m_goal, 0)/tau_prot*s_prot*np.minimum(f_ATP, 1), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-18) and np.allclose(Q_prot_demand, n_0*L*np.maximum(m - m_goal, 0)/tau_prot, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(Q_aa_rel, n_0*L*(r_prot - r_down), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12) and np.all(Q_aa_rel >= 0) and np.allclose(Q_aa_use, n_0*L*phi_aa*r_build, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12)

invariants.description: the copies built are paid for: n_0 L (c_syn + c_poly) / N_A (m(t) - m(0) - int (r_down - r_prot) dt) = int (J_build + J_saved) dt (relative 1e-4: trapezoid integration of the logged fluxes)
invariants.expr: abs(n_0*L*(c_syn + c_poly)/N_A*(m[-1] - m[0] - np.trapz(r_down - r_prot, t)) - np.trapz(J_build + J_saved, t)) <= 1e-4*abs(np.trapz(J_build + J_saved, t)) + 1e-4*n_0*L*(c_syn + c_poly)/N_A*np.trapz(r_prot, t) + 1e-30

invariants.description: with synthesis unregulated (R_syn = 1) expression approaches its regulated target and never overshoots: m moves monotonically towards m_goal (constant in these tests)
invariants.expr: np.all(R_syn < 1) or (np.all(np.diff(m)*np.sign(m_goal[0] - m[0]) >= -1e-12) and np.all((m - m_goal)*(m[0] - m_goal) >= -1e-12))
np.all(J_keep >= 0) and np.all(J_build >= 0) and np.all(J_prot >= 0) and np.all(J_saved >= 0) and np.all(M_build >= 0)

invariants.description: regulation (exact): R_reg = prod (1 - reg_on + reg_on f) and m_goal = m_target R_reg; with every switch off R_reg is exactly 1
invariants.expr: np.allclose(R_reg, (1 - reg_on_ATP + reg_on_ATP*f_ATP_reg)*(1 - reg_on_G6P + reg_on_G6P*f_G6P_reg)*(1 - reg_on_glc + reg_on_glc*f_glc_reg)*(1 - reg_on_H + reg_on_H*f_H_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(m_goal, m_target*R_reg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and (reg_on_ATP or reg_on_G6P or reg_on_glc or reg_on_H or np.all(R_reg == 1.0))

bc_sweep.rationale: expression over the range the game offers (x0.25-4); ATP from near exhaustion to above rest; synthesis from stalled to unconstrained; the ATP regulation from full repression to none; replacement synthesis from stopped to full; proteolysis from stalled to unconstrained; new copies from glucose only to recycled amino acids only
